title: 心理学基礎実験実習Ⅰ
subtitle: Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments I
keywords: Psychological experiment 2.Data analysis 3.Report writing 4.Sensasion, Perception, Cognition 5.Social behavior
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to understand the concept of experimental psychology and to acquire deeper knowledge of experimental methods to obtain accurate results through exercises of elementary psychological experiments. Students will also learn statistical analysis and evaluation of experimental data and basic skill of writing psychological reports.
advice: The class will be roughly divided into three terms with a total of five experiments (the themes of experiments are subject to change). In this class, students participate in the entire process of psychological research using experimental methods, namely conducting experiments (especially experiments on sensation and perception, memory, cognition and social behavior), analyzing the experimental data, and writing paper on the results of experiments. Throughout the semester students will participate in several cycles of research (conducting experiments, analysis, writing reports). It is very important to have practical experience in conducting experiments, to understand psychological phenomena and to analyze the data, and to acquire skill of writing report. Therefore, marks will be deducted for absence and tardiness. Students must bring their own PC to every class. This course is also linked to "Psychological Statistical Methods" and "Psychological Experiments," which are offered at the same semester, so students are expected to gain a deeper understanding of how to conduct experimental research in psychology considering the relationship with the contents of these courses.
books: Writing Manual of the Japanse Psychological Association. Other materials will be indicatd in each topic.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of psychology and experimental methods studied in the “Introduction to Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research”courses in the previous semesters is required.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand basic concept of psychological experiments.
Ability to adequately conduct psychological experiments.
Ability to analyze experimental data in adequate methods.
Ability to write paper on psychological experiments following the appropriate format.

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand the concept of experiments in psychology through experiments and exercises. Acquire skills to conduct experiments related to sensory perception, memory, cognition, and social behavior. Acquire knowledge on how to conduct experiments to obtain accurate results and apply this knowledge to their own experiments. Ability to conduct appropriate statistical analysis of experimental data. Ability to write research papers reporting the results of experiments accurately and logically in an appropriate format.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the concept of experiments in psychology through experiments and exercises. Acquire skills to conduct experiments related to sensory perception, memory, cognition, and social behavior. Acquire knowledge on how to conduct experiments to obtain accurate results. Ability to conduct appropriate statistical analysis of experimental data. Ability to write research papers reporting the results of experiments in an appropriate format.
